So bahisīmagato taṁ cīvaraṁ kāreti. So katacīvaro—“paccessaṁ paccessan”ti bahiddhā kathinuddhāraṁ vītināmeti. Tassa bhikkhuno sīmātikkantiko kathinuddhāro.
7.e: A monk who has participated in the robe-making ceremony and whose meditation is going well takes his robe-cloth and leaves the monastery, thinking, “I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll return.” When he is outside the monastery zone, he has a robe made. When the robe has been made, he still thinks, “I’ll return,” but he remains outside the monastery zone until the end of the robe season. For that monk the robe season ends while he is outside the monastery zone.

7.s: Bhikkhu atthatakathino phāsuvihāriko cīvaraṁ ādāya pakkamati—“amukaṁ nāma āvāsaṁ gamissāmi; tattha me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi, no ce me phāsu bhavissati, amukaṁ nāma āvāsaṁ gamissāmi; tattha me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi, no ce me phāsu bhavissati, amukaṁ nāma āvāsaṁ gamissāmi; tattha me phāsu bhavissati vasissāmi, no ce me phāsu bhavissati, paccessan”ti. So bahisīmagato taṁ cīvaraṁ kāreti. So katacīvaro “paccessaṁ paccessan”ti sambhuṇāti kathinuddhāraṁ. Tassa bhikkhuno saha bhikkhūhi kathinuddhāro.
7.e: A monk who has participated in the robe-making ceremony and whose meditation is going well takes his robe-cloth and leaves the monastery, thinking, “I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll go to such-and-such a monastery. If my meditation goes well there, I’ll stay. If not, I’ll return.” When he is outside the monastery zone, he has a robe made. When the robe has been made, he still thinks, “I’ll return,” and they reach the end of the robe season together. For that monk the robe season ends together with the other monks.

7.s: Dveme, bhikkhave, kathinassa palibodhā, dve apalibodhā. Katame ca, bhikkhave, dve kathinassa palibodhā? Āvāsapalibodho ca cīvarapalibodho ca. Kathañca, bhikkhave, āvāsapalibodho hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vasati vā tasmiṁ āvāse, sāpekkho vā pakkamati “paccessan”ti. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, āvāsapalibodho hoti. Kathañca, bhikkhave, cīvarapalibodho hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cīvaraṁ akataṁ vā hoti vippakataṁ vā, cīvarāsā vā anupacchinnā. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cīvarapalibodho hoti. Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve kathinassa palibodhā.
7.e: “Monks, there are two obstacles for the ending of the robe season: the monastery obstacle and the robe obstacle. What’s the monastery obstacle? A monk stays in that monastery or he leaves intending to return. What’s the robe obstacle? A monk hasn’t made a robe, or he hasn’t finished it, or he’s expecting more robe-cloth.
7.t: 14. Discussion on obstacles and removal of obstacles (14. Palibodhāpalibodhakathā)

7.s: Katame ca, bhikkhave, dve kathinassa apalibodhā? Āvāsaapalibodho ca cīvaraapalibodho ca. Kathañca, bhikkhave, āvāsaapalibodho hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pakkamati tamhā āvāsā cattena vantena muttena anapekkho “na paccessan”ti. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, āvāsaapalibodho hoti. Kathañca, bhikkhave, cīvaraapalibodho hoti? Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cīvaraṁ kataṁ vā hoti, naṭṭhaṁ vā vinaṭṭhaṁ vā daḍḍhaṁ vā, cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cīvaraapalibodho hoti. Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve kathinassa apalibodhā”ti.
7.e: There are two removals of obstacles for the ending of the robe season: the removal of the monastery obstacle and the removal of the robe obstacle. What’s the removal of the monastery obstacle? A monk leaves that monastery without intending to return. What’s the removal of the robe obstacle? A monk has made a robe; or the robe-cloth is lost, destroyed, or burned; or his expectation of more robe-cloth is disappointed.”

7.s:
Idaṁ vatthu kathinassa,
kappissanti ca pañcakā;
Anāmantā asamācārā,
tatheva gaṇabhojanaṁ.
7.e:
This is the basis for the robe-making ceremony,
And five things are allowable;
Without informing, going without taking,
Just so eating in a group.

7.s:
Yāvadatthañca uppādo,
atthatānaṁ bhavissati;
Ñatti evatthatañceva,
evañceva anatthataṁ.
7.e:
And as much as you need, the given,
Is for those who have participated <j>in the robe-making ceremony;
Motion, just thus performed,
Just thus not performed.

7.s:
Ullikhi dhovanā ceva,
vicāraṇañca chedanaṁ;
Bandhano vaṭṭi kaṇḍusa,
daḷhīkammānuvātikā.
7.e:
Marking, and just washing,
And planning, cutting;
Tacking, hem, strip of cloth,
Strengthening, border lengthwise.

7.s:
Paribhaṇḍaṁ ovaddheyyaṁ,
maddanā nimittaṁ kathā;
Kukku sannidhi nissaggi,
na kappaññatra te tayo.
7.e:
Border crosswise, patch,
Dyeing, indication, hint;
Borrowed, stored, to be relinquished,
Not marked, apart from those three.

7.s:
Aññatra pañcātireke,
sañchinnena samaṇḍalī;
Nāññatra puggalā sammā,
nissīmaṭṭhonumodati.
7.e:
Apart from five or more,
With cut sections with panels;
Not apart from an individual, correctly,
He appreciates outside the monastery zone.

7.s:
Kathinānatthataṁ hoti,
evaṁ buddhena desitaṁ;
Ahatākappapiloti,
paṁsu pāpaṇikāya ca.
7.e:
The robe-making ceremony is not performed,
Thus it was taught by the Buddha;
Brand new, nearly new, old,
Rag, and from a shop.

7.s:
Animittāparikathā,
akukku ca asannidhi;
Anissaggi kappakate,
tathā ticīvarena ca.
7.e:
Without indication, without hint,
And not borrowed, not stored;
Not to be relinquished, marked,
And so with the three robes.

7.s:
Pañcake vātireke vā,
chinne samaṇḍalīkate;
Puggalassatthārā sammā,
sīmaṭṭho anumodati.
7.e:
Five or more,
Cut sections made with panels;
Performed by an individual, correctly,
He appreciates inside the monastery zone.

7.s:
Evaṁ kathinattharaṇaṁ,
ubbhārassaṭṭhamātikā;
Pakkamananti niṭṭhānaṁ,
sanniṭṭhānañca nāsanaṁ.
7.e:
In this way is the robe-making ceremony performed,
Eight key phrases for ending;
Departing, finished,
And decision, lost.

7.s:
Savanaṁ āsāvacchedi,
sīmā sahubbhāraṭṭhamī;
Katacīvaramādāya,
“na paccessan”ti gacchati.
7.e:
Hearing, disappointed expectation,
Monastery zone, ending together as the eighth;
Takes a finished robe,
He goes, thinking, “I won’t return.”

7.s:
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
hoti pakkamanantiko;
Ādāya cīvaraṁ yāti,
nissīme idaṁ cintayi.
7.e:
So, for him the robe season ends,
When he departs;
He goes taking robe-cloth,
Outside the monastery zone he thinks:

7.s:
“Kāressaṁ na paccessan”ti,
niṭṭhāne kathinuddhāro;
Ādāya nissīmaṁ neva,
“na paccessan”ti mānaso.
7.e:
“I’ll make it. I won’t return.”
For him the robe season ends when it’s finished;
Takes outside the monastery zone, thinking, “Just not,
And I won’t return.”

7.s:
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
sanniṭṭhānantiko bhave;
Ādāya cīvaraṁ yāti,
nissīme idaṁ cintayi.
7.e:
So, for him the robe season ends,
When he decides;
He goes taking robe-cloth,
Outside the monastery zone he thinks:

7.s:
“Kāressaṁ na paccessan”ti,
kayiraṁ tassa nassati;
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
bhavati nāsanantiko.
7.e:
“I’ll make it. I won’t return.”
While making it, it is lost;
So, for him the robe season ends,
When it is lost.

7.s:
Ādāya yāti “paccessaṁ”,
bahi kāreti cīvaraṁ;
Katacīvaro suṇāti,
ubbhataṁ kathinaṁ tahiṁ.
7.e:
Taking it, he goes, thinking, “I’ll return”,
He has the robe made outside;
When his robe is finished, he hears,
There the robe season has ended.

7.s:
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
bhavati savanantiko;
Ādāya yāti “paccessaṁ”,
bahi kāreti cīvaraṁ.
7.e:
So, for him the robe season ends,
When he hears about it;
Taking it, he goes, thinking, “I’ll return”,
He has the robe made outside.

7.s:
Katacīvaro bahiddhā,
nāmeti kathinuddhāraṁ;
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
sīmātikkantiko bhave.
7.e:
When the robe is finished, outside,
He remains until the robe season ends;
So, for him the robe season ends,
When he is outside the monastery zone.

7.s:
Ādāya yāti “paccessaṁ”,
bahi kāreti cīvaraṁ;
Katacīvaro paccessaṁ,
sambhoti kathinuddhāraṁ.
7.e:
Taking it, he goes, thinking, “I’ll return”,
He has the robe made outside;
When the robe is finished, thinking, “I’ll return”,
The robe season ends together with.

7.s:
Tassa taṁ kathinuddhāro,
saha bhikkhūhi jāyati;
Ādāya ca samādāya,
sattasattavidhā gati.
7.e:
So, for him the robe season ends,
Together with the monks;
And takes, with,
Seven with sevenfold outcome.

7.s:
Pakkamanantikā natthi,
chakke vippakate gati;
Ādāya nissīmagataṁ,
kāressaṁ iti jāyati.
7.e:
There is no ending by departing,
The outcome in the unfinished set of six;
Takes, outside the monastery zone,
“I’ll make”, he produces.

7.s:
Niṭṭhānaṁ sanniṭṭhānañca,
nāsanañca ime tayo;
Ādāya “na paccessan”ti,
bahisīme karomiti.
7.e:
Finished, and decision,
Lost, these three;
Taking it, he goes, thinking, “I won’t return”,
“I’ll make outside the monastery zone”.

7.s:
Niṭṭhānaṁ sanniṭṭhānampi,
nāsanampi idaṁ tayo;
Anadhiṭṭhitena nevassa,
heṭṭhā tīṇi nayāvidhi.
7.e:
Finished, also decision,
Also lost, these three;
Not decided, he does not think,
Below is the threefold method.

7.s:
Ādāya yāti paccessaṁ,
bahisīme karomiti;
“Na paccessan”ti kāreti,
niṭṭhāne kathinuddhāro.
7.e:
Taking it, he goes, thinking, “I’ll return”,
When outside the monastery zone, thinking, “I’ll make”;
“I’ll not return”, he has it made,
The robe season ends when the robe is finished.

7.s:
Sanniṭṭhānaṁ nāsanañca,
savanasīmātikkamā;
Saha bhikkhūhi jāyetha,
evaṁ pannarasaṁ gati.
7.e:
Decision, and lost,
Hearing, outside the monastery zone;
Together with the monks,
Thus is the outcome of the fifteen.

7.s:
Samādāya vippakatā,
samādāya punā tathā;
Ime te caturo vārā,
sabbe pannarasavidhi.
7.e:
With, unfinished,
Thus again with;
These four sections,
Are all fifteenfold.

7.s:
Anāsāya ca āsāya,
karaṇīyo ca te tayo;
Nayato taṁ vijāneyya,
tayo dvādasa dvādasa.
7.e:
And not as expected, as expected,
And business those three;
By this method one should here understand,
Three, twelve, twelve.

7.s:
Apavilānā navettha,
phāsu pañcavidhā tahiṁ;
Palibodhāpalibodhā,
uddānaṁ nayato katanti.
7.e:
Here the nine on without taking,
Fivefold on good meditation there;
Obstacles, removal of obstacles,
The summary is made from this method.”
